David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Jeroboam_1: Solomon's servant, son of Nebat, who rebelled against him (1 Kings 11:26), and was later made king of Israel (1 Kings 12:20)
Nebat_1: father of Jeroboam, an Ephraimite of Zeredah (1 Kings 11:26)
Ahijah_3: of the house of Issachar, father of Baasha (1 Kings 15:27)
Ahab_1: son of Omri and King of Israel (1 Kings 16:28)
Elijah_1: the prophet, Tishbite, who was of the settlers of Gilead (1 Kings 17:1)
Jehu_2: anointed king over Israel (1 Kings 19:16) at the direction of Elisha (2 Kings 9:1-3)
Nimshi_1: [grand]father of Jehu, King of Israel (1 Kings 19:16, 2 Kings 9:2)
Elisha_1: anointed prophet in Elijah's place (1 Kings 19:16)
Naboth_1: the Jezreelite whose vineyard Ahab took (1 Kings 21:1)
Jehoram_2: King of Israel (2 Kings 1:17) and son of Ahab (2 Kings 3:1)
Ahaziah_2: King of Judah, youngest (2 Chronicles 21:17) son of Jehoram (2 Kings 8:24) son of Jehoshapat
Jehoshaphat_4: son of Nimshi, father of Jehu (2 Kings 9:2)
